comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Leases radiosurgery equipment to hospitals for per-procedure fees; therapeutic, not diagnostic imaging centers billing insurers.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: In-home nursing and personal care, mostly Medicaid-funded; different service and setting from outpatient diagnostic imaging.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Manufactures radiopharmaceutical imaging agents sold as products; a pharma supplier, not an imaging-center operator.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Outpatient mental health clinics; same reimbursement model but different clinical service and no imaging or software.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Outpatient physical therapy clinics; similar outpatient reimbursed model but different service than diagnostic imaging.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Acute care hospitals and behavioral facilities; far broader inpatient business than outpatient diagnostic imaging.
